newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks gain further in OTC market. [corrected 10:00 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks gain further in OTC market. [corrected 10:00 gmt]

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter securities market in Varazdin and its Osijek outpost for Thursday, October 10.
* Eight of 12 active issues rose, two fell and two were flat.
* 10-stock VIN index up 5.58 (Corrects from 2.58) percent to 9,260 (Corrects from 9,110) points.
* Volume lower at 8,824 units, turnover 632,026 German marks.
* The only two losers were hoteliers Jadranturist and Riviera Porec:
- Jadranturist was down 9.09 percent to 100 marks, on volume of 1,328 shares.
- Riviera Porec 6.25 percent down to 75 marks, with 61 shares sold.
* Biggest gainer was textile firm Varteks, up 150 percent to 50 marks with 3,508 shares sold. Others:
- Hotelier Suncani Hvar, adding 92.86 percent to 27 marks, on volume of 550 units.
- Jadranski Naftovod rose 28 percent to 800 kuna, with 12 shares traded.
- Hotelier Istraturist Umag was up 14.86 percent, to 85 marks, selling 511 units.
- Cable maker Elka and hotelier Plava Laguna Porec both added 14.29 percent to 80 and 400 marks respectively, selling 407 and 118 shares.
- Food processor Podravka was up 5.33 percent to 79 marks, on volume of 817 shares.
- Tour operator Atlas Dubrovnik rose 3.57 percent to 58 marks, with 325 shares traded.
- Hotelier Arenaturist at 70 marks, on volume of 837 shares.
- Chocolate maker Kras at 200 marks, with 350 units sold.
